user.title: Sungrow EMS
user.description: Connect to your Sungrow hybrid inverter and, optionally, the iHomeManager over local Modbus TCP. Everything stays on your local network unless you turn on the optional PVOutput.org upload.

data_description.inverter_host: IP address or hostname of the inverter's WiNet-S / LAN Modbus TCP interface.
data_description.inverter_port: Modbus TCP port of the inverter. Default 502.
data_description.inverter_device_id: Modbus unit (slave) ID of the inverter. Default 1.
data_description.ihm_enabled: Poll the iHomeManager for grid, load, battery totals and the EV charger.
data_description.ihm_host: IP address or hostname of the iHomeManager. Required when the iHomeManager is enabled.
data_description.ihm_port: The iHM listens on 502, 503 and 504 and allows ONE connection per port. Default 503. Use 504 while another integration still holds 503.
data_description.ihm_device_id: Fixed at 247 by the iHM protocol. Only change this if Sungrow support tells you to.
data_description.pvoutput_enabled: Also upload solar and consumption data to PVOutput.org. Off by default; you can change this later in the options.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Sungrow EMS
reconfigure.description: Change hosts, ports or unit IDs. The inverter serial number must stay the same.

data_description.inverter_port: Modbus TCP port of the inverter. Default 502.

pvoutput_account.title: PVOutput.org account
pvoutput_account.description: Enter the API key and system ID from pvoutput.org (Settings > API Settings). They are checked against PVOutput before continuing.

data_description.pvoutput_api_key: Must have write access (not a read-only key).
data_description.pvoutput_system_id: The numeric ID of the PVOutput system to upload to.
data_description.pvoutput_tier: Donation accounts can also send extended values v7 to v12 and battery values b1 to b5, and have a higher hourly request limit (300 instead of 60). The choice is checked against what PVOutput reports for the key.
data_description.pvoutput_upload_mode: Live sends a status every few minutes. Daily sends one total per day.

pvoutput_live.title: PVOutput live status
pvoutput_live.description: System: {system}. Status Interval on pvoutput.org: {interval} minutes.

data.pvoutput_cumulative: Send lifetime PV energy as v1

data_description.pvoutput_interval_mode: Auto follows the Status Interval set on pvoutput.org (checked again at every start). Uploads are aligned to the clock, e.g. :00, :05, :10.
data_description.pvoutput_cumulative: Energy mode only. Off (recommended): v1 is today's PV energy. On: v1 is the inverter's lifetime PV counter and c1=2 is sent so PVOutput works out the daily value itself.
data_description.pvoutput_send_values: Power (recommended): v2 generation and v4 consumption in W; PVOutput works out the energy. Energy: v1 and v3 in Wh; PVOutput works out the average power. Only one pair is sent.

pvoutput_daily.title: PVOutput daily output
pvoutput_daily.description: System: {system}. Today's totals are sent once a day at this local time.

data_description.pvoutput_daily_time: Local time. Default 23:55, close to the end of the day so the totals are nearly complete.

pvoutput_mapping.title: PVOutput values
pvoutput_mapping.description: Choose which value is sent for each PVOutput parameter. Auto uses the recommended Sungrow EMS value. A value that is unavailable (or a reading that means "no data", such as 0 V or 0 % SoC) is left out of that upload instead of being sent as 0. Donation accounts: b1 to b5 are battery values (auto by default; PVOutput needs b1 for any of them). v7 to v12 can be fed from any Home Assistant entity, for example a weather station; leave a field empty to not send it. Extended values must also be set up on pvoutput.org (Settings > Extended Data).

data_description.pvoutput_v1: Energy mode. Auto: Daily PV generation (Wh), or the lifetime counter when that option is on.
data_description.pvoutput_v2: Power mode. Auto: PV DC power (W).
data_description.pvoutput_v4: Power mode. Auto: Load power from the iHomeManager, else from the inverter (W).
data_description.pvoutput_v5: Auto: Inverter temperature (°C). Left out when the inverter reports 0 (asleep).
data_description.pvoutput_v6: Auto: Grid voltage from the iHomeManager meter, else inverter phase A (V). Left out below 90 V.
data_description.pvoutput_v7: Any numeric entity. Empty = do not send. Unavailable or non-numeric states are skipped.
data_description.pvoutput_v8: Any numeric entity. Empty = do not send. Unavailable or non-numeric states are skipped.
data_description.pvoutput_v9: Any numeric entity. Empty = do not send. Unavailable or non-numeric states are skipped.
data_description.pvoutput_v10: Any numeric entity. Empty = do not send. Unavailable or non-numeric states are skipped.
data_description.pvoutput_v11: Any numeric entity. Empty = do not send. Unavailable or non-numeric states are skipped.
data_description.pvoutput_v12: Any numeric entity. Empty = do not send. Unavailable or non-numeric states are skipped.
data_description.pvoutput_b1: Auto: battery power, + charging / - discharging (W). Required for b2 to b5.
data_description.pvoutput_b2: Auto: inverter battery SoC, else the iHomeManager's (%). Left out at 0 %.
data_description.pvoutput_b3: Auto: reported capacity x (Max SoC - Min SoC), in Wh.
data_description.pvoutput_b4: Auto: inverter lifetime battery charge (Wh). The SH10RS reports this counter wrongly, so it is then left out; choose "Total battery charge cumulative" to send the integration's own counter instead.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the inverter. Check the host, port and that nothing else holds the connection.
error.not_sungrow: The device answered but rejected the Sungrow identity registers. Check the unit ID.
error.no_serial: The inverter did not report a serial number (registers 4990-4999).
error.ihm_host_required: Enter the iHomeManager host, or turn off "Use iHomeManager".
error.ihm_cannot_connect: Could not connect to the iHomeManager. It allows one connection per port: try port 504 while another integration uses 503.
error.not_ihm: The device on that port is not an iHomeManager (device type code is not 0x072A).
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.invalid_auth: PVOutput rejected the API key or system ID (HTTP 401/403). Check both and that the key has write access.
error.pvoutput_rate_limited: PVOutput's hourly request limit has been reached. Try again later.
error.pvoutput_invalid_system: PVOutput did not accept the system ID.
error.pvoutput_cannot_connect: Could not reach pvoutput.org. Check the internet connection of Home Assistant.
error.pvoutput_donation_not_active: PVOutput reports that this API key is not in donation mode (60 requests per hour). Choose "Free account", or donate on pvoutput.org first.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: That is a different inverter (serial number changed). Add it as a new entry instead.

init.title: Sungrow EMS options
init.description: Polling, reliability, energy model, control and PVOutput.org upload settings. Saving reloads the integration.

data.spike_max_daily: Spike filter: largest plausible daily total
data.spike_rebaseline_count: Spike filter: readings needed to accept a new baseline

data_description.inverter_scan_interval: Seconds between inverter polls. 10 s is the recommended default.
data_description.ihm_scan_interval: Seconds between iHomeManager polls. Each poll makes about 3 requests spaced by the minimum gap, so keep this at 10 s or more.
data_description.timeout: Seconds to wait for each Modbus response.
data_description.retries: Extra attempts after a timeout, dropped connection or busy reply.
data_description.ihm_request_interval: The iHM protocol requires at least 1.0 s between requests.
data_description.failure_threshold: Consecutive failed polls (or invalid readings for one register) before entities show unavailable. Until then the last good value is kept.
data_description.battery_capacity: Rated battery capacity in kWh. 0 = automatic: use the capacity the hardware reports (iHomeManager register 8147, then inverter registers 13039 and 5639). If none of them report it, Battery usable energy and the time estimates show unavailable until you enter a value here.
data_description.spike_max_jump: Grid Import/Export Safe ignore a single step larger than this (kWh). Default 50.
data_description.spike_max_daily: Daily Consumption treats a daily import or export above this as corrupt and uses 0 instead. Default 200.
data_description.spike_rebaseline_count: After this many consecutive, consistent out-of-range readings the Safe meters accept the new value instead of holding the old one forever. Default 3.
data_description.control_enabled: Off by default: the integration only reads. When on, a small set of settings can be written (Backup reserve, iHM energy management mode, EV charger mode, forced charge). Every write is range-checked, rate-limited, skipped when nothing changes and read back to confirm. The next step has the control settings.
data_description.pvoutput_enabled: Upload solar and consumption data to PVOutput.org. When on, the next steps ask for the account, schedule and values.

control.title: Control
control.description: Writes change settings on your inverter and iHomeManager. Only the settings listed in the README can be written, and only within their documented ranges. Settings changed here also change in the iSolarCloud app.

data.ac22_unit: AC22 unit ID behind the WiNet-S

data_description.control_allow_unverified: Also allow writes that are not in Sungrow's protocol documents or not yet confirmed on hardware: the AC22 charge current and the EV charger's Time plan mode. Leave off unless you are testing them.
data_description.ac22_unit: Unit ID of the AC22 in the WiNet-S web device list. 0 = no EV charge current control. The AC22 is reached through the inverter's connection.
data_description.force_charge_timeout: A forced charge is stopped and the previous settings are restored after this many minutes, even if the target is not reached.

options.donation: Donation account — v7–v12, battery b1–b5 and higher rate limits

options.auto: Auto — sync with the pvoutput.org Status Interval

options.battery_charge_cumulative: Total battery charge cumulative (Wh, Sungrow EMS)

pvoutput_not_enabled.message: PVOutput upload is not enabled for any loaded Sungrow EMS entry (or not for the one given). Turn it on in the integration options.

control_not_enabled.message: Control is not enabled for any loaded Sungrow EMS entry (or not for the one given). Turn on Enable control in the integration options.

control_ambiguous.message: More than one Sungrow EMS entry has control enabled. Give config_entry_id.

pvoutput_push_now.name: Push to PVOutput now
pvoutput_push_now.description: Sends one PVOutput upload immediately with the configured mode and values (live status or daily output), to test the setup. Ignores a pending rate-limit pause.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Only this Sungrow EMS entry. Leave empty for every entry with PVOutput enabled.

set_backup_reserve.name: Set backup reserve
set_backup_reserve.description: Sets the inverter's Backup reserve SoC (register 13100). On grid, a battery below the reserve is charged up to it. Needs Enable control.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Sungrow EMS entry. Only needed when more than one has control enabled.

percent.name: Reserve
percent.description: Backup reserve in %, from Min SoC to 100.

force_charge_start.name: Start forced charge
force_charge_start.description: Charges the battery to a target SoC, then restores the previous energy management settings. Ends on the target, on the time limit, on cancel and when Home Assistant stops. Needs Enable control.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Sungrow EMS entry. Only needed when more than one has control enabled.

target_soc.name: Target SoC
target_soc.description: Stop at this battery level (%). At most Max SoC.

power_kw.name: Charge power
power_kw.description: Charge power in kW (iHM or inverter Compulsory mode). Default: the iHM's charge/discharge upper limit (register 8149).

timeout_minutes.name: Time limit
timeout_minutes.description: Stop after this many minutes even if the target is not reached. Default: the option.

method.name: Method
method.description: ihm_compulsory (iHM Forced mode, default with an iHM), inverter_compulsory (no iHM only) or reserve (raise the Backup reserve; the inverter charges and holds the level itself).

force_charge_cancel.name: Cancel forced charge
force_charge_cancel.description: Stops a running forced charge and restores the previous settings.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The Sungrow EMS entry. Only needed when more than one has control enabled.
